scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w client-3d && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && npm test -w client && npm test -w server && npm test -w client-3d
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w client-3d && npm run typecheck -w server
